Elyan Aarts <e.j.j.aarts@uva.nl>:
Dear avicenna team, I am a PhD researcher at the University of Amsterdam and am setting up an experience sampling study. I am considering my options for which app to use, and Avicenna looks like it fits our interests. Would it be possible to provide me with an indication of the pricing? We will only use survey data. At first, we will conduct a pilot study with max 20 participants. The full study will consist of around 200 participants. Please let me know if you need more information from us. I am looking forward to your response. Best wishes, Elyan Aarts PhD Candidate University of Amsterdam The Netherlands------

Hanna Badalpoor <sales@avicennaresearch.com>:
Dear Elyan, I hope you're doing well. My name is Hanna from Avicenna and I would be more than happy to help you with your request. Generally, our pricing depends on three factors: The type of data you plan to collect (only surveys and experience sampling, or sensor data as well) The participation period (how long each participant will be enrolled in your study) The maximum number of participants you expect to enroll I would be able to provide you with an exact quote if you let me know of the participation period of your study. Sincerely, Hanna --Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com-- On Monday, September 23, 2024 at 1:00:11 PM,
